mission:
Our mission is to document, understand, and conserve the rich biodiversity of Amrita University and its surroundings through systematic observation, scientific documentation, and community participation. By combining scientific curiosity with citizen science, we aim to create awareness that inspires meaningful conservation efforts.
•	Conduct biodiversity surveys to document birds, insects, mammals, reptiles, amphibians, plants, fungi, and other life forms present on campus. 
•	Build a comprehensive biodiversity inventory of Amrita University. 
•	Contribute observations to global citizen science platforms such as iNaturalist and eBird. 
•	Participate in international biodiversity initiatives including the Great Backyard Bird Count (GBBC), City Nature Challenge, and other citizen science projects. 
•	Organize biodiversity walks, workshops, identification sessions, awareness campaigns, and conservation outreach programs. 
•	Develop digital resources such as biodiversity databases, campus species checklists, field guides, and educational materials. 
•	Encourage interdisciplinary participation by involving students from all academic backgrounds in biodiversity documentation and conservation.
aboutClub:
Amrita BioArc is the official Species Identification and Biodiversity Club of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri Campus. The club was established with the vision of fostering biodiversity awareness through species identification and citizen science. We believe that conservation begins with awareness, and awareness begins with observation.
By encouraging students to observe, identify, and document the diverse flora and fauna around them, the club helps members understand the ecological importance and conservation status of different species. Through field surveys, educational activities, and participation in global citizen science initiatives, Amrita BioArc aims to cultivate a community of environmentally conscious individuals committed to preserving biodiversity.
The university campus and its surrounding landscape serve as an ideal natural laboratory, offering a unique opportunity to document and study the rich biodiversity present within the region.
joiningProcedure:
Membership is open to all students of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, irrespective of their academic discipline.
To become a member:
1.	Complete the club registration form (https://forms.office.com/r/8dQUMf7gkG ). 
2.	Join the club's official communication platform. 
3.	Participate in club meetings, biodiversity surveys, workshops, and citizen science activities. 
No prior experience in species identification is required. The only requirement is curiosity, enthusiasm, and a willingness to learn about nature
